questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Indiana?
What does Indiana law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Indiana: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In Indiana, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Indiana issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
